channel.title: on Industrial Manufacturing Knowledge Base
channel.description: Open industrial manufacturing knowledge base: aluminum & magnesium die casting, CNC machining, injection molding, tooling, materials, automotive manufacturing and supplier selection. 50+ engineering articles and reference tables.

item.title: Die Casting Die Design: Structure, Slides and Ejection
item.description: How high pressure die casting dies are built: cover and ejector halves, cavity inserts, slides, lifters, ejection systems, venting and overflow design.

item.title: Die Life and Thermal Fatigue: Heat Checking Explained
item.description: Why die casting dies fail: thermal fatigue and heat checking mechanisms, soldering, erosion and cracking, plus realistic die life expectations by alloy.

item.title: Hot Runner vs Cold Runner Systems: Selection Guide
item.description: Comparing hot runner and cold runner injection molds on cost, cycle time, material waste, resin compatibility, maintenance risk and program volume.

item.title: Injection Mold Design Fundamentals for Plastic Parts
item.description: Core principles of injection mold design: plate configurations, cavity layout, gate types, shrinkage compensation, venting, cooling and steel choice.

item.title: Injection Molding Defects: Diagnosis and Correction
item.description: Diagnosing injection molding defects: short shots, flash, sink marks, voids, weld lines, jetting, burn marks, splay, warpage and their corrections.

item.title: Injection Molding Process Parameters and Process Window
item.description: Setting injection molding process parameters: melt and mold temperature, injection velocity, V/P switchover, pack pressure, cooling and process windows.

item.title: Mold and Die Maintenance: Preventive Program Design
item.description: Building a preventive maintenance program for molds and dies: shot count triggers, level 1-3 tasks, waterline descaling, lubrication and storage.

item.title: Tool Steels for Dies: H13 Selection and Heat Treatment
item.description: Selecting and heat treating hot work tool steels for die casting dies: H13 grades, ESR quality, vacuum hardening, tempering and surface treatments.

item.title: Tooling Lead Time and Tryout: From Kickoff to T1 and T2
item.description: Tooling lead time explained stage by stage, from kickoff and DFM through steel cutting, heat treat, T1 and T2 sampling, engineering changes and PPAP.
